tagline: Sinai's laid-back dive town — boat access to Blue Hole and Gabr El Bint.
summary: Dahab is a laid-back Sinai coastal town, world-famous for freediving and shore-diving sites. Its waterborne draw is boat access along the shore to sites such as Gabr El Bint and the Blue Hole area. For Navier Experiences it's a premium dive-and-coast node; there is no scheduled transit series, so economics are null.

seasonality: Red Sea/Gulf of Aqaba is diveable year-round; summer heat is extreme. Aqaba waters are sheltered.
